claims.text: The release states that the King appointed Lord Tangi as Interim Speaker of the Legislative Assembly 'effective as of today, Friday 17th of November 2017' under Clause 61, to invite nominations for Prime Minister Designate and to convene the secret-ballot meeting. The writ was to be returned on or before 30 November 2017.
claims.uncertainty: Procedural. The page is dated 20 November 2017 while the text says 'today, Friday 17th'; both are recorded as printed.
